set.approach: Leave the car at the little pullout beyond the second Athabasca crossing, with the slabs in view beside the river. A steep path climbs from the lot to the top of the slabs, and a walk along the top of the rock leads to the anchors. The route is an easy line at the river side of the slabs.

review.notes: Area page: parking, steep path to top, walk along top. Route page: river side, anchors at top. No descent stated for this route (area page says only some routes need a rappel to the river).
